## Question

The website gains an interactive explorer of the gene-sharing network drawn in Fig. 6b,
so that readers can locate VCX and every other Infomap module, inspect members, and see
where modules connect. This step exports the static data files the explorer loads; the
page itself lives in `www/network/`.

Inputs: node coordinates and edges of panel b (step 103, the same layout as the figure),
module membership and network attributes of the analysis network (step 100), and
vOTU annotations and iPHoP predictions from `pc028e3.sqlite`. Joins use exact
identifiers; building the adjacency list is linear in the number of edges.

## Design

The page uses deck.gl 9.4 (MIT): an `OrthographicView` with a `ScatterplotLayer` for the
nodes and `LineLayer`s for edges, all fed from binary buffers. Edges are shown in three
levels: the overview draws every node plus module-to-module summary edges, a selection
draws the real edges of the selected node or module, and the full set of 2,301,056
edges is drawn on request. A Web Worker computes selection edges from the CSR list.
The interface offers a VCX preset, search, an inspector, colour modes, shareable URL
state, PNG export and a note that layout distance is not a similarity measure.

## Nodes

```{r}
#| label: nodes
#| cache: false
df_nodes <- readr::read_tsv(path_source("103-fig6-dendrogram", "panel-b-nodes.tsv.gz"),
  show_col_types = FALSE)
df_edges <- readr::read_tsv(path_source("103-fig6-dendrogram", "panel-b-edges.tsv.gz"),
  show_col_types = FALSE)
df_net <- readr::read_tsv(path_source("100-reviewer-revision", "figure6-network-nodes.tsv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE, guess_max = 20000)
con <- DBI::dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), here::here("pc028e3.sqlite"), flags = RSQLite::SQLITE_RO)
df_votu <- DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT vOTU_id, contig_repid, class, family, lifestyle,
  host_Chicken, host_Duck, host_Goose, host_Coturnix, host_Pigeon, host_Bird, host_Egret
  FROM contig_annotation_filtered_vOTU")
df_hosts <- DBI::dbReadTable(con, "host_filtered")
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
df_host_phylum <- df_hosts |>
  dplyr::mutate(phylum = stringr::str_match(Host.taxonomy, "p__([^;]+)")[, 2]) |>
  dplyr::distinct(contig_id, phylum) |>
  dplyr::group_by(contig_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(host_phylum = if (dplyr::n() == 1) phylum[[1]] else "Multiple phyla",
    .groups = "drop")
bird_groups <- function(chicken, duck, goose, other) {
  purrr::pmap_chr(list(chicken, duck, goose, other), function(c, d, g, o)
    paste(c("Chicken", "Duck", "Goose", "Other birds")[c(c > 0, d > 0, g > 0, o > 0)], collapse = ";"))
}
df_explorer <- df_nodes |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_net |> dplyr::select(label = tree_label, genome_name, module_id, vOTU_id,
    length = network_sequence_length, quality = network_sequence_quality),
    by = "label", relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_votu, by = "vOTU_id", relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  dplyr::left_join(df_host_phylum, by = c(contig_repid = "contig_id"), relationship = "many-to-one") |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    family = dplyr::if_else(is.na(family) | stringr::str_starts(family, stringr::fixed("[")),
      NA_character_, family),
    class = dplyr::if_else(is.na(class) | stringr::str_starts(class, stringr::fixed("[")),
      NA_character_, class),
    birds = dplyr::if_else(node_set == "catalog",
      bird_groups(dplyr::coalesce(host_Chicken, 0), dplyr::coalesce(host_Duck, 0),
        dplyr::coalesce(host_Goose, 0), dplyr::coalesce(host_Coturnix, 0) +
          dplyr::coalesce(host_Pigeon, 0) + dplyr::coalesce(host_Bird, 0) + dplyr::coalesce(host_Egret, 0)),
      NA_character_),
    host_phylum = dplyr::if_else(node_set == "catalog", dplyr::coalesce(host_phylum, "No prediction"),
      NA_character_))
stopifnot(nrow(df_explorer) == 17838, all(df_explorer$node_index == seq_len(17838) - 1L),
  sum(df_explorer$vcx) == 266, all(df_explorer$module_id[df_explorer$vcx] == 44))
knitr::kable(df_explorer |> dplyr::summarise(nodes = dplyr::n(), with_module = sum(!is.na(module_id)),
  catalog = sum(node_set == "catalog"), catalog_with_vOTU = sum(!is.na(vOTU_id)),
  with_family = sum(!is.na(family)), with_host_prediction = sum(host_phylum != "No prediction", na.rm = TRUE)))
```

## Adjacency and modules

The explorer stores the undirected edges as a symmetric compressed sparse row (CSR)
list: `offsets` has one entry per node plus one, and the neighbours of node *i* are
`targets[offsets[i]:offsets[i+1]]`. Module statistics and the module-to-module edge
counts give the explorer a backbone view and the neighbour ranking of any module.

```{r}
#| label: adjacency-modules
#| cache: false
n_nodes <- nrow(df_explorer)
dt_adj <- data.table::rbindlist(list(
  data.table::data.table(from = df_edges$source_index, to = df_edges$target_index),
  data.table::data.table(from = df_edges$target_index, to = df_edges$source_index)))
data.table::setorder(dt_adj, from, to)
offsets <- c(0L, cumsum(tabulate(dt_adj$from + 1L, nbins = n_nodes)))
stopifnot(length(offsets) == n_nodes + 1L, offsets[n_nodes + 1L] == 2L * nrow(df_edges),
  max(dt_adj$to) < 65536L)
module_of <- df_explorer$module_id
dt_mod_edges <- data.table::data.table(a = module_of[df_edges$source_index + 1L],
  b = module_of[df_edges$target_index + 1L])[!is.na(a) & !is.na(b) & a != b]
dt_mod_edges[, `:=`(m1 = pmin(a, b), m2 = pmax(a, b))]
dt_backbone <- dt_mod_edges[, .(edges = .N), by = .(m1, m2)][order(-edges)]
df_modules <- df_explorer |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(module_id)) |>
  dplyr::group_by(module_id) |>
  dplyr::summarise(members = dplyr::n(), catalog = sum(node_set == "catalog"),
    refseq = sum(node_set == "refseq"), x = stats::median(x), y = stats::median(y), .groups = "drop") |>
  dplyr::mutate(composition = dplyr::case_when(refseq == 0 ~ "Catalog only",
    catalog == 0 ~ "RefSeq only", TRUE ~ "Mixed"),
    label = dplyr::if_else(module_id == 44, "VCX (module 44)", paste("Module", module_id)))
internal_edges <- data.table::data.table(m = module_of[df_edges$source_index + 1L],
  m2 = module_of[df_edges$target_index + 1L])[!is.na(m) & m == m2, .(internal = .N), by = m]
df_modules <- df_modules |> dplyr::left_join(internal_edges, by = c(module_id = "m")) |>
  dplyr::mutate(internal = dplyr::coalesce(internal, 0L))
vcx_neighbours <- dt_backbone[m1 == 44 | m2 == 44][, .(module = ifelse(m1 == 44, m2, m1), edges)]
readr::write_tsv(dt_backbone, path_target("module-backbone.tsv"))
knitr::kable(head(vcx_neighbours, 8), caption = "Modules sharing the most edges with VCX in the displayed network")
```

## Web files

```{r}
#| label: web-files
#| cache: false
dir_web <- path_target("web")
dir.create(dir_web, showWarnings = FALSE)
write_bin <- function(x, file, what, size) {
  con <- file(file.path(dir_web, file), "wb")
  writeBin(what(x), con, size = size, endian = "little")
  close(con)
}
write_bin(offsets, "csr-offsets.u32", as.integer, 4)
write_bin(dt_adj$to, "csr-targets.u16", as.integer, 2)
codes <- function(v) { lev <- sort(unique(stats::na.omit(v))); list(levels = lev, codes = ifelse(is.na(v), -1L, match(v, lev) - 1L)) }
fam <- codes(df_explorer$family); cls <- codes(df_explorer$class); hp <- codes(df_explorer$host_phylum)
jsonlite::write_json(list(
  n = n_nodes, edges = nrow(df_edges),
  x = round(df_explorer$x, 1), y = round(df_explorer$y, 1),
  label = df_explorer$label, name = dplyr::coalesce(df_explorer$genome_name, df_explorer$label),
  set = as.integer(df_explorer$node_set == "refseq"), module = dplyr::coalesce(df_explorer$module_id, -1L),
  vOTU = dplyr::coalesce(df_explorer$vOTU_id, ""), length = dplyr::coalesce(df_explorer$length, -1),
  quality = dplyr::coalesce(df_explorer$quality, ""), lifestyle = dplyr::coalesce(df_explorer$lifestyle, ""),
  birds = dplyr::coalesce(df_explorer$birds, ""),
  family = fam$codes, family_levels = fam$levels, class = cls$codes, class_levels = cls$levels,
  host_phylum = hp$codes, host_phylum_levels = hp$levels),
  file.path(dir_web, "nodes.json"), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = NA)
jsonlite::write_json(list(
  modules = df_modules,
  backbone = dt_backbone[edges >= 50],
  presets = list(vcx = list(module = 44L, label = "VCX (Fig. 6b)"))),
  file.path(dir_web, "modules.json"), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = NA, dataframe = "rows")
knitr::kable(tibble::tibble(file = list.files(dir_web),
  MB = round(file.size(file.path(dir_web, list.files(dir_web))) / 1e6, 2)))
```
